origin: Own ideal one-dimensional chemical-storage layer with reversible linear uptake, reflecting back face and finite surface exchange. This is a constructed linear-response diffusion problem, not measured electrode data, a named chemical reaction or a microscopic proof from an equivalent circuit. Fixed units make all listed coefficients dimensionless. The independent geometric length measurement below is part of the input.
field_model: A slab occupies0<x<L. Chemical potential perturbationmu and stored concentration perturbationc obeyc=chi*mu, chi>0 constant, fluxj=-M*partial_x mu,M>0, and chi*partial_t mu=M*partial_xx mu. Thus chemical diffusivityD=M/chi. Initiallymu=0. The back face is reflecting, partial_x mu(L,t)=0. At the exposed face j(0,t)=k_s[mu_ext(t)-mu(0,t)],k_s>0. This j is positive INTO the slab; full external potential is not automatically the surface potential. No double-layer capacitor, advective flux or extra contact impedance is present.
harmonic_convention: Use mu_ext(t)=Re[exp(i*omega*t)] and the same PLUS-iomega convention for all response fields. Define admittanceY=j(0)/mu_ext and impedanceZ=1/Y. Choose the square-root branch continuously with Re sqrt(iomega/D)>0 for omega>0. Derive the finite-length harmonic boundary-value solution and full impedance; prove it does not depend on an arbitrary square-root sign when both factors are handled consistently. A conjugated response corresponds to a different time convention and is not an interchangeable output here.
calibrated_spectral_information: For s=iomega nearzero, independent exact constructed asymptotic summaries are Z(s)=0.5/s+1.75-0.1*s+O(s²). First infer the COMPLETE set of positive(chi,M,L,k_s) compatible with these summaries, then derive the s²coefficient as a model check. The attached CSV contains separate binary64-rounded admittance validation values at omega0.02,0.2,2,20; preserve real and imaginary signs and use residual tolerance1e-10. Demonstrate which combinations of parameters the ENTIRE frequency response can identify. Parameterize every isospectral scaling usinga>0 relative to any valid solution and report the power exponents ofchi,M,D underL->aL. A finite validation panel cannot by itself prove structural identifiability or a unique microscopic model.

independent_geometry_measurement.status: Exact constructed geometric calibration independent of admittance.

registered_harmonic_and_passivity_checks: Using the independent geometry, construct the actual complex boundary coefficient for thecosh profile satisfying the reflecting back face, and retain a complete registered real linear-system solution for BOTH real and imaginary parts at every CSV frequency. Reconstruct the full field, surface flux and impedance from those actual solutions, compare all complex values to the CSV and closed form, and verify the full boundary residual. Derive and numerically verify the integrated dissipation/storage identity relating mu_ext_conjugate*j to M*integral|mu_x|²+|j|²/k_s+iomega*chi*integral|mu|². This identity establishes passivity and the sign convention, rather than inferring it from a Nyquist plot. Use actual converged spatial integrations or an equivalent exact integral evaluation.
step_experiment: Separately apply mu_ext(t)=1for t>0 from the empty initial condition. Determine the COMPLETE real relaxation eigenvalue structure of the finite slab with its surface Robin condition and reflecting back face. Derive the scalar eigenvalue equation, prove exactly one admissible positive root in each appropriate interval and exclude an unphysical zero root. Retain the first SIX dimensionless wavenumbersbeta_n in increasing order, their positive decay rates, and projection amplitudesA_n for the UNFILLED fraction1-Q(t)/(chi L). Here Q(t)=integral_0^L c(x,t)dx. Obtain these amplitudes from the initial uniform deficit and the correct eigenfunction inner product, not by fitting exponentials. The full infinite series has a physical normalization; a truncated list must not be artificially rescaled.
finite_time_and_limit_checks: Compute Q(t) and the surface fluxj(0,t)=dQ/dt at t0.1,1,5 with controlled eigenmode truncation/refinement. Prove the long-time decay rate and both its unfilled-fraction and flux prefactors. Derive the right-hand initial flux and its leading sqrt(t)drop from the local semi-infinite ROBIN problem, distinguishing finite surface exchange from an imposed surface potential. Independently evaluate that semi-infinite flux formula at the same3times with actual registered Gaussian-tail calculations or an equivalent converged integral, and explain its finite-layer long-time failure. A semi-infinite approximation is a local short-time limit, not the finite-layer solution for all times. Also derive lim Y/(iomega) at low frequency and limYat high frequency; identify why the constant low-frequency impedance coefficient is not solely a surface resistance.

interpretation_proposals.A: A complete frequency response can identify composite transport/storage scales while leaving an exact geometric scaling ambiguity.
interpretation_proposals.B: Every finite-length low-frequency real impedance intercept equals the bare surface resistance.
interpretation_proposals.C: The reflecting boundary changes long-time uptake from a semi-infinite tail to discrete relaxation modes.
interpretation_proposals.D: A partial list of projection amplitudes must be normalized tosum1before reconstructing physical uptake.
interpretation_proposals.E: An integrated storage/dissipation identity checks the physical phase convention and passivity.
interpretation_proposals.F: Matching only the real response validates either sign of the imaginary admittance under a fixed harmonic convention.
interpretation_proposals.G: An independent geometric measurement can remove an otherwise exact diffusivity/length ambiguity.
interpretation_proposals.H: A finite synthetic spectral match establishes a unique microscopic exchange mechanism in a real electrode.

reporting: Declared frequency/time orders above, first-six modes ascending, parameter tuple orderL,chi,M,D,k_s*L/M. The first identified tuple order ischi*L,L²/D,k_s. Numerical absolute tolerance1e-7; source CSV residual1e-10; scale exponents and predicates exact. The long-time unfilled fraction is normalized by FULL capacitychi*L, whereas totalQandj use physical units. A mode amplitude list is a partial spectral expansion, not a six-category probability distribution. Preserve full source records, inverse-family proof, actual complex boundary solves and passivity checks, complete eigenvalue intervals, projection/truncation derivations and short/long-time scope in the trajectory.

primary_context.title: Transmission line circuit and equation for an electrolyte-filled pore of finite length
primary_context.context: Primary context for Robin/Neumann finite-domain relaxation and its impedance correspondence. The chemical-potential storage coefficients and inverse/transient panel here are own inputs.

context_role: The governing field equations and constructed calibrations above fully define the scientific task. External diffusion-impedance literature supplies motivation only; no paper data, fractional model or undocumented empirical boundary condition is imported.
